Run lifecycle

Telomere Method

Every workload is different. The settlement standard stays the same: define the ceiling, meter the work, and settle only what ran. Four steps, one verifiable record.

[

01

]

Discover

Choose the hardware class, image, region, and lane that fit your workload.

→ CPU, GPU, sealed, interruptible

[

02

Define

Set your spending ceiling and the owner rules that every run must respect.

→ Hourly caps, daily limits, expiry

[

02

[

03

[

For hosts

Supply the compute

Turn eligible hardware into compute capacity. Bring your machine, your ideas, and your reliability.

Independent hosts

Install the Host Kit on Linux, register a host key, post collateral, and pass the performance probes. Earn the price you post for receipted compute.

A common standard

Every host uses the same metering semantics. Probes check the declared hardware class; signed ticks and an in-cell heartbeat measure live runs.

What hosts provide

  • A supported CPU or GPU configuration.

  • A host key and sufficient collateral.

  • The capacity to run allowlisted images.

Host classes

  • CPU Cells with gVisor isolation.

  • GPU Cells with NVIDIA hardware.

  • Sealed Cells with confidential computing.

  • Interruptible capacity with a checkpoint notice.

Supply the compute

Configure a host profile, review the collateral requirements, and understand the metering and probe standard before bringing capacity online.
